newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Moody's assigns ICBC Aa3 rating.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns ICBC Aa3 rating.

text.p: Moody's said on Thursday it had assigned rating of Aa3 long-term and Prime-1 short-term to International Commercial Bank of China.
The Taiwan bank was also assigned C-Plus rating in its financial strength, it said.

The ratings reflected the bank's status as a major commercial bank in Taiwan, which has a strong franchise in foreign exchange business and is an important bank for the larger corporations in Taiwan, and a close relationship with the Nationalist government, its largest shareholder, Moody's said.

The ICBC benefited from good financial fundamentals. Its core franchises with large corporations and in foreign exchange business were strong and the bank's government connections were the source of both profitable business and confidence, it said.
Its core profitability was high, but the bank also had a high expense base due to its expenditure on its retail and middle market business, the rating agency said.

The bank maintained a "very strong" liquidity position, a long-standing policy related to the requirements of tis important government business, as well as its sensitive position as a leading government bank in the Taiwan banking system, Moody's said.
